verdict.rationale: Framer maps code to design through Code Components, which are custom React components with visual controls, and Code Overrides. Designs ship directly as live sites through Framer's publishing pipeline, and a community user notes its React basis allows widget handoff to developers. There is no evidence of exporting design-to-code output into a developer's own codebase; the shippable output stays inside Framer-hosted publishing. Missing for 10: documented code export of designs, design-to-codebase component mappings for external apps, hands-on corroboration of shippable exported code.

support.subject: As a developer, designs map to production code — component-to-code mappings or direct design-to-code output I can actually ship

citations.quote: Code Components Custom React Components with visual controls to render anything on your site.
Code Overrides Higher Order Components to modify Layer and Component properties.
Staging environments. Test changes securely on a framer.app domain before pushing live.
Framer X is based on React, so designers can theoretically make a widget, and then hand it off to developers in order to hook up any back end services.
